ordinary_ticker_ex_date.note: No separate exchange ex-date notice was used; issuer explicitly confirms start of split-adjusted trading.

events.implementation_note: If a vendor Close series is expressed throughout in post-August-2-2021 share units solely for this reverse split, actual pre-split price per old share equals that Close divided by 8; a recorded post-split share equals eight pre-split shares. This conditional transformation does not establish what Yahoo Close currently contains, nor account for other adjustments.
limitations: No vendor prices, split event payload, dividend amounts or return reconstruction were checked.
Do not apply the split a second time to an already split-adjusted total-return series.

ordinary_ticker_ex_distribution_date.note: Ordinary GE regular-way shares carry the child entitlement through the January 3 distribution date, with distribution completed at 17:00 and GEHC trading starting January 4. This is a derived ordinary-market adjustment date; no standalone issuer/SEC exchange ex-date declaration was located.

events.auxiliary_market_note: A separate ex-distribution market existed before the distribution, while ordinary GE regular-way trading retained the entitlement. Its earlier date must not be substituted for the ordinary GE series adjustment date.
limitations: Official action terms alone do not validate Yahoo Adj Close's treatment of the distribution.

To use the main-line reinvestment policy, value the 1/3 GEHC distribution on the selected date and reinvest according to the documented policy; avoid double-counting it if vendor adjustments already include the distribution.

events.main_successor_issuer: General Electric Company, operating as GE Aerospace

ordinary_ticker_ex_distribution_date.note: The issuer distinguishes regular-way GE with entitlement through April 1 from auxiliary GE WI without entitlement. April 2 is the derived ordinary-market adjustment date; no standalone issuer/SEC exchange ex-date declaration was located.

limitations: GEV is a distributed child; the main GE column remains GE Aerospace rather than switching to GEV.
No prices or vendor-adjustment behavior were checked; distribution valuation/reinvestment remains a calculation policy to verify.

ordinary_ticker_ex_distribution_date.note: Ordinary MMM with entitlement was announced through March 28, the last pre-distribution trading day; March 29 was not a regular US market trading day. Distribution occurred April 1 before market open. This is a derived ordinary-market adjustment date; no standalone issuer/SEC exchange ex-date declaration was located.

limitations: 3M's retained 19.9% company stake does not alter the shareholder's 1-for-4 distributed-child ratio.
No prices or vendor-adjustment behavior were checked; value of distributed SOLV and reinvestment timing remain to be tested.

global_limitations: This file confirms only four specified corporate-action terms; it is not a complete GE/MMM action inventory.
Ordinary-ticker ex-distribution dates are explicitly marked as derived from issuer/SEC entitlement and completion/trading evidence, rather than independent exchange ex-date announcements.
Issuer-linked SEC PDFs and 3M's issuer-linked Form 8937 are hosted on official document CDNs linked from the corresponding issuer investor pages.

Dividend, split and spin-off adjustment behavior in Yahoo Close/Adj Close must be diagnosed from the actual fetched series before manual reconstruction. No market data were fetched, ingested or changed in this task.
No formal report or accepted main-stage dataset was changed.
